messages:
nina: heads-up: opened PR #901 to harmonize retry middleware behavior in Ruby SDK with node/python. main issue: retry-before-auth vs auth-before-retry causing duplicated token fetches and failing Sidekiq jobs.

omar: saw the diff. curious why we did retry-first historically? I thought Faraday recommended retry middleware outermost.

cheng: historically we layered Retry -> Auth to avoid touching headers on failed attempts, but that meant when token_provider refreshed on 401 the retried request still used old header. Node/python run auth per-request which avoids this.

nina: exactly. PR changes ordering to Auth -> Retry and makes auth middleware call token_provider on each attempt. Also adds `max_refresh_attempts: 1` to avoid refresh storms.

omar: code snippet in PR looks clean. one nit: ensure token_provider can be sync or return a future-like (callable that might raise). docs should show simple proc and an async lambda example for async token fetchers.

cheng: tests? I see unit tests but can we add an integration that simulates token expiry mid-request and asserts only one refresh call and one retry? Would prevent regressions.

qa-bot: request: add flaky test run tag for integration. We had an intermittent failure when CI env slowed and token refresh timed out. Use `stub_timeout: 2s` in test harness.

nina: good call. I'll add integration test in sample-app-ruby that uses WEBrick test server to return 401 once then 200. assert token_provider called exactly once. Also add backoff jitter check is within expected range.

omar: for changelog: mention parity with node/python and migration note: existing users passing static `access_token:` will continue to work but we recommend switching to `token_provider` for long-lived processes. plan to deprecate static token in 4 months.

cheng: review: please ensure middleware docs clarify ordering and include a diagram. New maintainers often get tripped by Faraday middleware order.

ci-bot: PR #901 CI status: 6 checks running. Current failures: ruby-2.7/macos-arm (ffi native build) — see earlier thread.

omar: if CI keeps failing on ffi, maybe mock out network layer in unit tests so native build not required. Integration will still run on linux runners.

nina: will adjust matrix: run integration only on ubuntu-latest and add allowed_failure for macos-arm for now. will follow up on ffi separately.

cheng: can we add a tiny snippet to README quickstart showing `Client.new(token_provider: -> { refresh_token! })` and Sidekiq example to avoid support noise?

nina: yep adding README update and sample-app change. Also adding a deprecation ISSUE to track static token removal and customer outreach.

ci-bot: PR #901 tests passed at 1835012378. merging after 1 more approval.

omar: nice! thanks everyone :rocket:
